HavenSpace for Mac, Windows and Android. Download the one for your device from https://havenspace-app.vercel.app/#devices

These are test builds without a paid developer signature yet, so your device asks once before opening them:

- **Mac:** open `HavenSpace-Mac.dmg` and drag HavenSpace to Applications. The first time you open it, macOS says it can't check the app: click **Done**, then open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** run `HavenSpace-Windows-Setup.exe`. If "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Android:** download `HavenSpace-Android.apk` and open it. If asked, allow your browser to install apps. If Play Protect warns you, tap **More details → Install anyway**.

The apps open the same HavenSpace you use in the browser, so they always have the newest features.
